name: El Ronquillo (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, yellow and green, the yellow charged with the crowned municipal arms of El Ronquillo (a cypress on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of El Ronquillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Ronquillo arms — cypress on yellow
cap of the crown of the arms
